newsitem.title: CROATIA: Rating agencies visit Croatia for assessment.
newsitem.headline: Rating agencies visit Croatia for assessment.

text.p: Three leading international agencies visited Croatia's main ministries and institutions to assess its sovereign rating, Finance Ministry said on Thursday.
Representatives of IBC Ltd, Moody's Investors Service Inc and Standard & Poor's Corp came to Croatia 10 days ago, the Ministry said in a statement carried by state news agency HINA.
The Ministry expects the agencies to complete the assessment of Croatia's sovereign rating before the end of the year.
Croatia has an eye on a BBB rating to reduce the price of future borrowings on international capital markets.
It is also aiming to attract large institutional investors to a $150 million maiden issue of Eurobonds due next year.

But one of Croatia's two credit rating advisers, Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS), has warned political troubles in neighbouring Bosnia may thwart the country's chances of getting the desired rating despite its good indicators. --Laura Lui, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
